offering_description.value: Owns and operates destination and regional ski resorts, selling lift tickets, season passes, lessons, equipment rental and dining to skiers and snowboarders. Also operates lodging and retail shops at its mountains.

primary_products.value: season passes; lift tickets; ski and snowboard equipment and apparel retail; food and beverage

primary_services.value: ski and snowboard lessons; equipment rentals; lodging; resort dining; property management

customer_segment.value: B2C: skiers, snowboarders and resort vacationers; B2B: group and corporate event customers, lodging partners

end_markets.value: ski and mountain resort recreation; leisure travel; hospitality

revenue_model.value: product sales: season passes, lift tickets and retail merchandise; service fees: ski school, equipment rental, dining and lodging; rental or leasing: equipment rentals and commercial space leases
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs ski resorts, lifts, hotels and restaurants serving individual guests; retailer: sells ski gear and apparel at resort shops to guests

geography_served.value: global: resorts in the US (Colorado, California, Utah, Vermont, others), Canada, Australia and Switzerland

specialization.value: related lines: lift access, ski school, rentals, dining, lodging and retail at resorts

distribution_channels.value: online: pass and lift ticket sales via website and app; own locations: resort ticket windows, retail and rental shops, lodging; partners / resellers: third-party ticket resellers and travel partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land use permits on US national forest land (US Forest Service), lift safety, environmental and labor rules
